title: Ordinary scalar-adjoint tensor formula for strict systems
statement: Use the ordinary systems and section-normalized comparisons of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models, def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. For ordinary strict semilinear systems M,N, the adjoint of horizontal restriction on their tensor equals ordinary evaluation tensor comparison followed by the scalar tensor comparison and the tensor of the two horizontal adjoints. The equation uses the ordinary adjunction and pure-section normalization of Data; neither adjoint need be invertible.

source.place: Zheng Construction 4.1 horizontal system restrictions, with Stacks Tags 03EK, 03CZ and 06YY for module tensors and scalar adjunctions.

proof.text: Transpose the two composites through the actual extension/restriction adjunction. Precompose with inverse evaluation tensor comparison. Sheafification adjunction and generation of a module tensor by pure sections reduce equality to a pair of ordinary local sections.

source.place: Zheng Construction 4.1 horizontal system restrictions, with Stacks Tags 03EK, 03CZ and 06YY for module tensors and scalar adjunctions.

proof.text: The adjunction unit sends a section to its scalar-extension section. The scalar tensor comparison sends the extension of a pure tensor to the tensor of the extended sections. Actual horizontal restriction of a pure tensor is the tensor of its restrictions, and ordinary evaluation preserves pure sections. Thus the two transposes agree, and injectivity of the adjunction bijection proves the formula.

theorem ordinary_tensor_reduction (A : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ) {m n : ℕ}
    (h : n ≤ m) (M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) :
    ordinaryReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h
        (ordinaryTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
          (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) M N) ≫
      (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J B τ n M N).hom =
    (A.scalar h).model.E.map
        (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J B τ m M N).hom ≫
      ((A.scalarTensorModel h).ordinary
        ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj M)
        ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj N)).hom ≫
      ordinaryTensorHom.{c, v, r} J (B n)
        (ordinaryReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h M)
        (ordinaryReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h N)
